title: Mastra agent with Postgres memory
description: A Mastra agent that remembers users in Neon Postgres, streams chat for useChat on AI Gateway, and runs a resumable human-in-the-loop review workflow.

environment.name: MASTRA_FUNCTION_TOKEN
environment.description: Random token (at least 32 characters, for example from openssl rand -hex 32) callers send as Authorization: Bearer <token>; required because Neon Function URLs are public.

operations.title: Chat with memory
operations.description: POST the useChat body plus a resourceId to stream a reply; Mastra Memory keeps the thread and a per-user profile in Postgres.

operations.title: Load a thread
operations.description: POST a threadId and resourceId to get the thread's messages in the UIMessage format useChat takes.

operations.title: Review a draft
operations.description: POST a brief to start a workflow that drafts text and suspends for approval; POST the runId with approved and optional feedback to resume it.
